findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with a bare `pass`, but StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract members counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and the newly added build_occurrence_and_event_data, none of which are implemented here. Python will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler` when Detector.detector_handler does `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, crashing process_detectors for any detector of type metric_alert_fire instead of previously evaluating to an empty result. Stub implementations (or leaving the handler non-stateful until it is implemented) are needed.
